intro.what: Present Perfect zamoni o'tmishda boshlangan, ammo hozirgi paytda ham muhim bo'lgan harakatlarni bildiradi. Biz uni asosan hayotdagi tajribalar va o'tmishdagi ishlarning hozirgi natijasidan gapirish uchun ishlatamiz. U Have/Has va fe'ning 3-shakli (V3) yordamida yasaladi.
when: Natijasi hozir ham ko'rinib turgan ishlar uchun
Ma'lum vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan ishlar haqida
Aniq vaqti ko'rsatilmagan o'tmishdagi ishlar uchun

structures.label: For va Since bilan
structures.example_en: We have lived here for five years.

rules.title: Ever va Never ishlatilishi
rules.text: Ever so'zi savol gaplarda tajribani so'rash uchun ishlatiladi, never esa darak gapda inkor ma'noni beradi.

examples.en: Have you ever seen a bear?
I have never flown in a helicopter.

rules.title: Just, Already va Yet
rules.text: Just yaqinda tugagan ishga, already oldinroq bajarilgan ishga, yet esa inkor va so'roq gaplarda oxirida qo'llaniladi.

examples.en: Dad has just washed his car.

rules.title: For va Since farqi
rules.text: For davomiylik vaqtini (masalan, 3 years), since esa ish boshlangan aniq vaqtni (masalan, 2015) ko'rsatadi.

examples.uz: Aziza ikki oydan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqda.

examples.en: Aziza has studied English since September.
examples.uz: Aziza sentyabrdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqda.

rules.title: Been va Gone farqi
rules.text: Been – borib kelganligini, gone – ketib hali qaytib kelmaganini bildiradi.

rules.title: Present Perfect va Past Simple
rules.text: Present Perfect natijaga e'tibor qaratadi, Past Simple esa aniq o'tmish vaqti bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.uz: Men ruchkamni yo'qotib qo'ydim (hozir ham yo'q).

mistakes.why: Present Perfect zamonida fe'lning 3-shakli (gone) ishlatiladi, 2-shakli (went) emas.

mistakes.wrong: I have lived here since three years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for three years.
mistakes.why: Davomiylik vaqti (three years) uchun 'since' emas, 'for' ishlatiladi.
Hayotiy tajribani so'rashda Past Simple emas, Present Perfect ishlatiladi.
He, she, it olmoshlari bilan 'have' emas, 'has' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.
